summary: Project to replace/remove the 'My submission' area and implement a login page instead.

existing_features.title: Remove the “My Submissions” navigation entry from the header so users no longer see or access a My Submissions area from the main navigation.
Add a new Login page route at /login that allows users to authenticate with Internet Identity and to log out, using the existing Internet Identity hook.

Disable the existing /my-submissions experience by removing the MySubmissionsPage route and ensuring /my-submissions instead takes the user to the new /login page (via redirect or by rendering the Login page).
Update any UI that links to /my-submissions (e.g., the post-submit success state on Submit Story) to link to /login instead, with updated English button text.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement a login page (replace current 'My submission' area)

projectName: Replace My Submissions with a dedicated Login page
